A '''kuega''' was a type of jewelry worn by wealthy [[Gender/Legends|feminine]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]],<ref name="GCG" /> a [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]].<ref name="SoR">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> The name of the jewelry was also used as a feminine Sullustan name.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kuegas were mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]] and published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in [[2003]].<ref name="GCG" />
